name: Nature in the view from home raises well-being
claim: Residents whose windows showed natural elements reported more neighbourhood satisfaction and well-being; a view of built elements did not raise well-being.
caveat: Cross-section self-report in six US apartment communities; a correlation, not a cause; the sample size was not seen.

sources.title: Kaplan 2001, The nature of the view from home: psychological benefits, Environment and Behavior 33(4)
